answer: Every new identity posts a 40 POA bond in escrow and names a sponsor on a public referral graph. Its voyage from newcomer to trusted trader passes peer checkpoints: any peer may dispute a fake with evidence, and a proven dispute burns both bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA, and fakes sharing one sponsor carry a sable mark. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its haven of trading rights, and gets the bond back.
